title: No "I was invited" door
note: No invite can exist without a server, so the button that could only open a coming-soon sheet is gone. It is back when server features are on (J21). An invite link that is opened still lands on the coming-soon sheet.
text: The baby memory book you fill by talking. A few words at a time, in your own voice. Kept for your child to read and hear for years. Your first two letters are free. Begin the book
